mcat_description.short: Auditorium roofing sheds are large-span prefabricated steel roofing structures designed to cover assembly and gathering venues such as marriage halls, churches, community auditoriums, and banquet halls, typically supplied as a fabrication-and-erection turnkey service.
mcat_description.long: Auditorium roofing sheds are pre-engineered or custom-fabricated steel structural roofing systems built to span large column-free or minimal-column interior spaces for public assembly venues including marriage halls, churches, community halls, and institutional auditoriums. The primary structural frame comprises welded H-beam columns and rafters or truss systems fabricated from IS 2062 mild steel, with purlins in hot-dip galvanised C-section or Z-section steel supporting colour-coated or galvanised profiled roofing sheets. Structural design follows IS 800:2007 (General Construction in Steel) and IS 875 (Parts 1–3) for dead, live, and wind load calculations, with seismic zone compliance per IS 1893 where applicable. These structures are sold as site-specific turnkey projects — design, fabrication, supply, and erection — and are quoted per square foot of covered area.

market_context: Auditorium roofing sheds in India are a well-established segment within the broader prefabricated steel structure market, primarily serving the large and growing demand for marriage halls, churches, community auditoriums, and institutional assembly venues. The dominant structural system is a pre-engineered or custom-fabricated steel frame — welded H-beam columns and rafters or roof trusses — clad with colour-coated profiled steel sheets (PPGI) or sandwich insulation panels, with hot-dip galvanised C/Z-section purlins. Structural design compliance follows IS 800:2007 for general steel construction and IS 875 (Parts 1–3) for load calculations (dead, live, wind), with IS 1893 governing seismic zone requirements. Key material grades are IS 2062 structural mild steel for the primary frame and IS 12093-compliant galvanised sheets for roofing. The market is highly fragmented with regional fabricators and contractors dominating supply; suppliers are concentrated in Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, and Andhra Pradesh. Products are sold as turnkey fabrication-and-erection contracts, quoted per square foot of covered area. Buyer vocabulary strongly distinguishes by venue type: 'marriage hall shed', 'church shed', 'wedding hall shed' are the dominant search terms in the Indian market, confirming that venue application drives buyer intent rather than structural typology.
